{{Top|leg}}
'''Hunter-killer sats''' were [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] that were deployed to hunt down enemy [[communications satellite]]s. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] commonly deployed hunter-killer sats. The satellites were in turn regularly targeted by enemy [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
